rebuttalDraft.text: Merchant disputes Amex FR2 chargeback of $8,500.00 dated 2026-04-10. The transaction was fully authenticated via Amex SafeKey and EMV data is on record (see evidence [25de446e-8faa-5783-bfa6-519960b38749]). FraudShield AI reported a low-risk score of 18/100 at authorization time with no velocity anomalies (see evidence [5bde067c-7f9f-5161-8599-4ad1471cb699]). Our CRM confirms the cardholder contacted support on 2026-04-11 and our team responded within 4 hours (see evidence [36a43a73-f6f0-5e3d-bdaf-a0b1e7b7e3fe]). PCI-DSS certification renewal is in progress; the renewed certificate will be submitted as supplemental evidence prior to the response deadline.
